description: This file defines the CommonWidgetModels class, which contains shared widget model classes and related utility methods for a web framework. It includes nested classes representing widget components like images, links, parameters, and auto-parameter mechanisms, along with methods for parameter handling and callback propagation.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels
classes.description: A collection of shared/reused widget models and utility methods for building widget parameters, links, images, and managing callbacks in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels.AutoEntityParameters
classes.description: Handles auto-parameters extraction for entities, supporting exclusion lists and inclusion types, based on XML element configuration.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels.AutoServiceParameters
classes.description: Manages auto-parameters extraction for services, supporting exclusion lists and configuration via XML.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels.Image
classes.description: Represents an image widget, supporting various attribute configurations and context-based expansion.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels.Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink, including parameters, auto-parameters, callback, image, styling, and behavior attributes, with support for context expansion.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels.Parameter
classes.description: Represents a widget parameter, supporting static and dynamic (from field or event result) values.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels.ParameterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Parameter objects from map entries, converting values to String.

methods.name: propagateCallbackInParameterMap
methods.description: Propagates a callback into the parameter map, including JWT tokens if applicable.
